corner-bottom-left.description: A bottom-left corner of thin red and gold rules with a tall red acanthus leaf rising up the left rule, blue and gold leaves at the join, gold scrolls, green ivy leaves and red finials at the ends of both rules, on a transparent background.
corner-bottom-left.title: Acanthus corner, bottom-left
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges.
The red leaf climbs upward along the left rule.
Use as a whole image; it is not a rotation of another corner and not a border-image atlas.

corner-bottom-right.description: A bottom-right corner of thin red and gold rules with blue and gold acanthus leaves at the join, a red leaf rising up the right rule to a red finial, green ivy leaves along both rules, gold scrolls and a red finial at the left end, on a transparent background.
corner-bottom-right.quality: Drawn at a wider 3:2 aspect than the other three ruled corners, with a longer horizontal arm, so the set does not match exactly.
corner-bottom-right.title: Acanthus corner, bottom-right
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges.
The red leaf climbs upward along the right rule; the horizontal arm is longer than the vertical one.
Use as a whole image; it is not a rotation of another corner and not a border-image atlas.

corner-top-left.description: A top-left corner of thin red and gold rules with red and gold acanthus leaves springing upward above the join, a blue acanthus leaf curling down into the corner, gold scrolls, green ivy leaves and small red finials at the ends of both rules, on a transparent background.
corner-top-left.title: Acanthus corner, top-left
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges.
The leaves point up and left, outward from the page.
Use as a whole image; it is not a rotation of another corner and not a border-image atlas.

corner-top-right.description: A top-right corner of thin red and gold rules with a large blue acanthus leaf sweeping down and left from the join, a red leaf curling up and right, gold scrolls, green ivy leaves and blue finials at the ends of both rules, on a transparent background.
corner-top-right.title: Acanthus corner, top-right
usage_notes: Place at the top-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges.
The main blue leaf hangs down along the right rule.
Use as a whole image; it is not a rotation of another corner and not a border-image atlas.

divider-center.description: A symmetric horizontal centrepiece of blue acanthus leaves curling outward to both sides, an upright red leaf in the middle, gold lower lobes and a green ivy leaf hanging below a small gold knot, on a transparent background.
divider-center.title: Divider centrepiece
usage_notes: Centre piece of a three-part flexible divider with divider-start and divider-end; draw the connecting rule beneath it.
Also works alone as a section break.

divider-end.description: The right end of a horizontal divider: a blue acanthus leaf curling up, a red leaf curling down, gold lobes and tendrils and a green ivy leaf fanning out to the right from a small gold three-lobed cap at the left edge, on a transparent background.
divider-end.title: Divider, right terminal
usage_notes: Right piece of a three-part flexible divider with divider-start and divider-center.
The gold cap at the left edge is where a drawn rule should end; it is a separately drawn companion, not a mirror of divider-start.

divider-start.description: The left end of a horizontal divider: a blue acanthus leaf curling up, a red leaf curling down, gold lobes and tendrils and a green ivy leaf fanning out to the left from a small gold three-lobed cap at the right edge, on a transparent background.
divider-start.title: Divider, left terminal
usage_notes: Left piece of a three-part flexible divider with divider-center and divider-end.
The gold cap at the right edge is where a drawn rule should start; keep the piece upright.

floral-frame.description: A complete landscape rectangular frame with an opaque ochre-gold band filled with blue and red acanthus, green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, bounded by thin red rules, around a transparent opening, on a transparent background.
floral-frame.title: Floral frame
usage_notes: Complete frame for CSS border-image: the build records the slice (146 px on the master, 10.68 % of the width and 14.6 % of the height) and the resolver's frame() returns the rule; the opening is transparent.
Also fine as one proportionally scaled image with content in the opening.
ornate-inner-frame and the frame-growth corners share its palette.

frame.description: A complete landscape rectangular frame of thin red and gold rules with red, blue and gold acanthus leaves, green ivy and gold berries growing around the outside of the rules, around a transparent opening, on a transparent background.
frame.title: Ruled acanthus frame
usage_notes: Fixed complete frame with a transparent centre; scale it proportionally as one image.
Same rules and palette as the four ruled corners; its sides are not repeat tiles.

frame-growth-bottom-left.description: A bottom-left corner of gold, red and blue acanthus with green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, running along two edges without rules, on a transparent background.
frame-growth-bottom-left.title: Floral frame corner, bottom-left
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a page or box, flush with the two edges.
The four frame-growth corners form a matching set in the palette of floral-frame; inward-growth-bottom-left adds branches into the interior.
Use as a whole image; no rules, no border-image atlas.

frame-growth-bottom-right.description: A bottom-right corner of gold, red and blue acanthus with green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, running along two edges without rules, on a transparent background.
frame-growth-bottom-right.title: Floral frame corner, bottom-right

frame-growth-top-left.description: A top-left corner of gold, red and blue acanthus with green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, running along two edges without rules, on a transparent background.
frame-growth-top-left.title: Floral frame corner, top-left

headpiece.description: A wide, nearly symmetric headpiece: a tall blue acanthus crest with a gold base in the centre, flanked by blue and red acanthus curls, gold scrolls and green ivy leaves spreading to both sides, on a transparent background.
headpiece.title: Acanthus headpiece
usage_notes: Place above a title or at the head of a chapter; do not tile or stretch it.
Wide 3:1 piece; pairs with tailpiece at the end of the text.

horizontal-flourish.description: A low horizontal flourish on a gold stem: a red acanthus leaf curling at the left, a blue leaf in the centre, a gold leaf at the right, three green ivy leaves, a small red bud and curling tendrils at both ends, on a transparent background.
horizontal-flourish.title: Horizontal flourish
usage_notes: Airy section break or ornament beneath a heading; both ends are finished, no connecting rule.
Wide 3:1 piece; use as a whole image.

inward-growth-bottom-left.description: A bottom-left corner of gold, red and blue acanthus with green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, with extra branches reaching diagonally from the corner into the interior of the page, on a transparent background.
inward-growth-bottom-left.title: Inward-growing floral corner, bottom-left
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a page or box so the inner branches overlap the content area.
Variant of frame-growth-bottom-left with growth into the interior; the four inward-growth corners form a matching set.
Use as a whole image; no rules, no border-image atlas.

inward-growth-bottom-right.description: A bottom-right corner of gold, red and blue acanthus with green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, with extra branches reaching diagonally from the corner into the interior of the page, on a transparent background.
inward-growth-bottom-right.title: Inward-growing floral corner, bottom-right

inward-growth-top-left.description: A top-left corner of gold, red and blue acanthus with green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, with extra branches reaching diagonally from the corner into the interior of the page, on a transparent background.
inward-growth-top-left.title: Inward-growing floral corner, top-left

inward-growth-top-right.description: A top-right corner of gold, red and blue acanthus with green leaves, white five-petal flowers and red berries, with extra branches reaching diagonally from the corner into the interior of the page, on a transparent background.

leaf-sprig.description: A diagonal sprig on a gold stem rising from a small red bud at the lower left to a large curling blue acanthus leaf at the upper right, with two green ivy leaves and a fine gold spiral, on a transparent background.
leaf-sprig.title: Diagonal leaf sprig
usage_notes: Light asymmetric accent for section breaks or beside a heading; keep its orientation.

module-sprig.description: A compact upright sprig: a large blue acanthus leaf curling up and to the right, a gold leaf below it and a small red leaf at the lower right on a gold stem, on a transparent background.
module-sprig.title: Module sprig
usage_notes: Small marker placed before a heading, aligned to the cap height of the text.
Portrait canvas with little margin; give it space on the right.

ornate-inner-frame.description: A complete landscape rectangular frame of four red, blue and gold acanthus corners with green leaves, white flowers and red berries, joined by thin red and gold rules with a small gold knot at the middle of each side, around a transparent opening, on a transparent background.
ornate-inner-frame.title: Ornate inner frame
usage_notes: Lighter inner frame to nest inside floral-frame or to use alone; scale proportionally as one image.
Not sliced for border-image.

polyhymnia.description: The muse Polyhymnia, a veiled young woman in a cream gown, pink sleeves and a blue mantle, sits on a stone bench and plays a portative organ, head bowed and turned to the right, before a garden and a hilly landscape with a castle. The arched scene is set in an opaque gold border strewn with pink roses, blue cornflowers, pansies, white acanthus sprays, butterflies and a bird; only the outer edge is transparent.
polyhymnia.title: Polyhymnia playing a portative organ
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature for the Polyhymnia app; the painted border is part of the image, keep proportions.
Opaque: do not expect a transparent background behind the figure.

polyhymnia-logo-acanthus.description: A circular medallion frame: a red and gold ring surrounded by red, blue and gold acanthus leaves at the four diagonals, blue and red fleurons at top and bottom and green ivy leaves, around a transparent centre, on a transparent background.
polyhymnia-logo-acanthus.title: Polyhymnia logo medallion
usage_notes: Frame of the Polyhymnia app logo; keep the centre empty and overlay a portrait or mark in code.
Square canvas; the ring is centred.

rosette.description: A compact fourfold rosette turning around a small gold disc: alternating red and blue acanthus leaves with gold curls, and four green ivy leaves between them at the diagonals, on a transparent background.
rosette.title: Acanthus rosette
usage_notes: Compact section marker or chapter-end ornament; square canvas, use as one image.

saltarello-lower.description: A bottom-left corner piece for a left margin: a vertical gold rod edged in red, from which a horizontal spray of red and blue acanthus, green leaves and gold scrolls with white five-petal flowers and red berries grows to the right along the bottom; the rod runs up to the top edge of the canvas, cut so a drawn rule can continue it. Transparent background.
saltarello-lower.title: Saltarello margin rod, lower
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a text block, rod along the left margin and spray along the bottom; pairs with saltarello-upper.
Extend the rod with a drawn rule of the same width between the upper and lower pieces.

saltarello-lower-finished.description: A bottom-left corner piece for a left margin: a vertical gold rod edged in red, from which a horizontal spray of red and blue acanthus, green leaves and gold scrolls with white five-petal flowers and red berries grows to the right along the bottom; the rod ends at the top in a small blue and gold fleuron finial. Transparent background.
saltarello-lower-finished.title: Saltarello margin rod, lower, finished rod
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a text block, rod along the left margin and spray along the bottom; pairs with saltarello-upper-finished.
Self-contained: the rod is capped, so it needs no connecting rule.

saltarello-lower-simple.description: A bottom-left corner piece for a left margin: a vertical gold rod edged in red, from which a horizontal spray of red and blue acanthus, green leaves and gold scrolls in a lighter, muted palette with fewer berries grows to the right along the bottom; the rod ends at the top in a small blue and gold fleuron finial. Transparent background.
saltarello-lower-simple.title: Saltarello margin rod, lower, simple
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a text block, rod along the left margin and spray along the bottom; pairs with saltarello-upper-simple.
Self-contained: the rod is capped, so it needs no connecting rule.
Quieter palette for use beside dense text.

saltarello-upper.description: A top-left corner piece for a left margin: a vertical gold rod edged in red, from which a horizontal spray of red and blue acanthus, green leaves and gold scrolls with white five-petal flowers and red berries grows to the right along the top; the rod runs down to the bottom edge of the canvas, cut so a drawn rule can continue it. Transparent background.
saltarello-upper.title: Saltarello margin rod, upper
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a text block, rod along the left margin and spray along the top; pairs with saltarello-lower.
Extend the rod with a drawn rule of the same width between the upper and lower pieces.

saltarello-upper-finished.description: A top-left corner piece for a left margin: a vertical gold rod edged in red, from which a horizontal spray of red and blue acanthus, green leaves and gold scrolls with white five-petal flowers and red berries grows to the right along the top; the rod ends at the bottom in a small gold and blue foliate finial. Transparent background.
saltarello-upper-finished.title: Saltarello margin rod, upper, finished rod
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a text block, rod along the left margin and spray along the top; pairs with saltarello-lower-finished.
Self-contained: the rod is capped, so it needs no connecting rule.

saltarello-upper-simple.description: A top-left corner piece for a left margin: a vertical gold rod edged in red, from which a horizontal spray of red and blue acanthus, green leaves and gold scrolls in a lighter, muted palette with fewer berries grows to the right along the top; the rod ends at the bottom in a small gold and blue foliate finial. Transparent background.

Self-contained: the rod is capped, so it needs no connecting rule.

section-fleuron.description: A symmetric section ornament: a central red and blue foliate crest over gold lobes, gold curls to both sides, a green ivy leaf hanging below and two more on short gold side stems that end in red-tipped finials, on a transparent background.
section-fleuron.title: Section fleuron
usage_notes: Standalone section break; the capped side stems are part of the ornament, not rules to extend.

tailpiece.description: An upright foliate spray on a gold stem: a red acanthus leaf curling to the left, a tall blue leaf rising above, a curled gold leaf to the right and a small green ivy leaf at the base, on a transparent background.
tailpiece.title: Acanthus tailpiece
usage_notes: Place centred below the last paragraph of a chapter or section; pairs with headpiece.

title-ivy-close.description: A small closing sprig for a heading, of blue, gold and red acanthus leaves on a stem that runs from a green ivy leaf at the left to a gold three-lobed cap at the right. It sits after the last letter of a title, the cap outward; the background is transparent.
title-ivy-close.title: Title ivy, closing sprig
usage_notes: Place after the last letter of a heading; the matching opening bracket goes before the first letter.
Cut from the right half of the original two-piece canvas; the two pieces were drawn together and share scale and baseline.

title-ivy-open.description: A large opening bracket for a heading, of blue and red acanthus leaves curling to the right around a gold three-lobed cap, with two green ivy leaves on short stems. It sits before the first letter of a title and faces right into the text; the background is transparent.
title-ivy-open.title: Title ivy, opening bracket
usage_notes: Place before the first letter of a heading; the matching closing sprig goes after the last letter.
Cut from the left half of the original two-piece canvas; the two pieces were drawn together and share scale and baseline.

vertical-sprig.description: A slender upright sprig on a gold stem: a blue acanthus leaf curling to the right near the top, a red leaf curling to the left below it, three green ivy leaves, a red bud at the top and a curled gold root at the bottom, on a transparent background.
vertical-sprig.title: Vertical margin sprig
usage_notes: Standalone vertical margin ornament; keep it upright, it has no rule or repeat unit.
